text:
ivy: Quick thread 10 live-labs plan. Goal: convert hands-on attendees into activated users by bundling micro prompt packs + modest credit. Need routing, copy, and a cheap nudge test.
omar: Agree. Proposed arms:
- Control: baseline follow-up (no credits)
- P1: persona prompt pack only
- P2: prompt pack + 30 starter credits
- P3: prompt pack + 75 credits + timed 48h in-app nudge
lia: Metrics to track: registered, attended, pack_downloaded, credits_granted, credits_redeemed, first_successful_call, paid_30d. Also tokens_first_week.
ivy: Landing microcopy ideas: "Hands-on Redwood Lab: ship an LLM demo with our starter prompts" CTA variants to test: "Reserve spot", "Claim starter pack".
omar: Routing: add 'persona' dropdown (Product/Data/Infra) and include 'preferred_model' and 'fallback_model' in webhook. Also include cohort_id for experiment arm.
lia: Webhook sample payload (to inbound): {"event":"webinar_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"product","cohort_id":"lab-p2-2026"} (will paste proper snippet in doc).
icampaign-bot: Event created: live-lab-aug12. Reminders set at 72h, 3h, 15m.
ivy: Copy owner: @omar. Prompt packs owner: @lia. Instrumentation: @ivy. Deliverable EOD Fri.
lia: Quick UX experiment: show a floating "Use your starter credits" CTA in the dashboard for 5 days vs none. Run on 25% of P2/P3. Cap credits budget to $8k, alert #finance at 75%.
omar: Social blurb drafts:
1) "Build an LLM demo in one session 1 Aug 12. Starter prompts + credits for attendees."
2) "Reduce token costs with smart caching  join our live lab."
ivy: OK locking this in. I'll create the tracking doc and cohort ids now. Quick standup 9:30 tomorrow.
